title_1080p: GOR-9 • Watchroom Rounds & Star/Solar Shift Seamless Loop (14,285.7 kHz USB • 0400 GCT)
description:
Seamless 48-second watchroom rounds loop inside the +26.0m Octagonal Broadcast Booth on Asteroid 3-5-1, stopping at the telemetry consoles and gazing out through the panoramic windows as the Sun, Millisecond Pulsar PSR B1937+21, O.R.S. 351, and the Milky Way shift across the Oort Cloud sky.
14,285.7 kHz Upper Sideband • Epoch 2736.305 • 0400 Galactic Coordinated Time.

0:00 North Master Broadcast Cockpit & Show Director HUD (Perpendicular Console Tilt)
0:06 NE/East Panoramic Window Look-Up #1: Blazing Solar Corona (SOL) & Tumbling Basalt Asteroid Shift
0:12 East (+90°) ED-9 Euclidean Vector Scope & Brass Flatbed Plotter (Perpendicular Console Tilt)
0:24 South (180°) 3D Armillary Sphere & Panoramic Window Look-Up #2: Pulsar PSR B1937+21 & O.R.S. 351 Transit
0:36 West (-90°) HV-4 Klystron Exciter Tubes & West/NW Window 50 kW Marzelvane Cherenkov Sky Burst
